alerts.msg: OGEC / TRITON 0020-048E. Evergreen ad-hoc, 14,354 TEU via Panama. Yantian ETD 02 Sep, New York ETA 02 Oct, 30 days. Three days slower than SAX on the same pair. Note the port cut-off is 30 Aug, which is NOT the sailing date.

OGEC / EVER LASTING 0021-097E. Evergreen ad-hoc, 9,466 TEU via Panama. Shanghai ETD 06 Sep, New York ETA 11 Oct, 35 days. Twelve days slower than SAX on the same pair. Adds Boston and Baltimore calls.

OGEC voyage numbers 0020 and 0021 are consecutive with unrelated rotations, so OGEC is a rolling ad-hoc programme rather than a one-off. Expect roughly one new voyage per week and check for 0022 next run.

Seed run covered Evergreen on three lanes only and Hapag-Lloyd on one, over a 4-week rather than 8-week horizon. CMA, Maersk, ONE, MSC and Wan Hai were not swept. Full sweep begins with the first automated run.
